dedupe_keys.name: c2es physical risk toolkit directory of climate hazard data and tools for company risk assessment

description: The Physical Risk Toolkit lists data sources and tools that companies can use to assess physical climate risk, mainly publicly available US federal and academic resources plus some widely used private tools. The Center for Climate and Energy Solutions assembled it in 2022 from web searches and from feedback in its 2021 project on how companies assess climate risk. Its 36 entries, such as the Aqueduct Water Risk Atlas and NOAA's billion-dollar disasters list, are tagged by historic or projected time scale, national, regional or global coverage and smallest scale, hazard topic from heat and drought to flooding, sea level, tropical cyclones and wildfire, information type, level of difficulty, visualisation and provider, including NOAA, NASA, USGS, USACE, EPA, First Street Foundation, Climate Central and WRI. Coverage is mainly the United States. Format and access: a filterable web table with a download. Licence: not stated; free. Caveats: it dates from 2022 and C2ES does not endorse the private tools listed. It is a starting point for choosing hazard exposure and climate adaptation data for infrastructure owners. Related catalogue records are the US Climate Resilience Toolkit and the UNEP FI climate risk tools dashboard.
